service: 24/7 CDRRMO Emergency Disaster Response & Rescue Hotline
description: Round-the-clock emergency medical response, vehicular accident extrication, flood/typhoon rescue, and disaster relief dispatch operated by the City Disaster Risk Reduction & Management Office (CDRRMO) Roxas City.
steps: Dial CDRRMO Roxas City 24/7 Operations Center: (036) 621-0500 or Mobile: 0977 204 9641 / 0927 509 1198.
Clearly state your name, exact location (Barangay, landmark, street), and nature of emergency.
Stay on the line while dispatch directs emergency ambulance or rescue units to the scene.
requirements: Emergency incident details and callback contact number

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Anyone requiring urgent assistance within Roxas City

sources.name: Roxas City Disaster Risk Reduction & Management Office

service: Agricultural Crop Support & Farm Inputs Distribution
description: Distribution of certified high-yield palay seeds, organic bio-fertilizers, and farm machinery assistance for agrarian communities in Roxas City.
steps: Verify enrollment in the Registry System for Basic Sectors in Agriculture (RSBSA).
Proceed to the City Agriculture Office during scheduled cropping season distribution.
Claim allocated certified seeds and bio-fertilizer vouchers.
requirements: RSBSA Farmer Registration Stub / ID
Barangay Certification confirming active cultivation of agricultural land in Roxas City

sources.name: Department of Agriculture Region VI / Roxas City Agriculture Office

service: Annual Business Permit Renewal
description: Annual renewal of Mayor's Permit for active commercial establishments operating in Roxas City, processed every January with early-payment incentives.
steps: Submit previous year's Mayor's Permit and certified Gross Receipts / Income Tax Return.
Secure clearances from City Health, CENRO, and Bureau of Fire Protection at the BOSS Center.
Pay business license taxes and regulatory fees at the City Treasurer's Office.
Receive renewed Mayor's Permit and current year registration sticker.
requirements: Previous Year Mayor's Permit and Official Receipts
Audited Financial Statement or Sworn Statement of Gross Receipts
Current Barangay Business Clearance
Current Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (BFP Roxas City)

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Existing business owners in Roxas City
quickInfo.fee: Based on gross sales tax brackets

sources.name: Roxas City Revenue Code

service: Application for Marriage License
description: Filing of application for marriage license for contracting parties where at least one party is a resident of Roxas City.
steps: Both applicants submit required documents at LCRO Roxas City.
Undergo Pre-Marriage Counseling (PMC) with City Health and CSWDO.
Complete 10-day statutory public posting period.
Claim Marriage License at LCRO (valid for 120 days nationwide).
requirements: PSA Birth Certificate of both parties
PSA Certificate of No Marriage (CENOMAR)
Barangay Certificate of Residency from Roxas City
Valid Government IDs of both parties
Parental Consent (for ages 18-21) or Parental Advice (for ages 22-24)

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Couples planning marriage where at least one party is a Roxas City resident

sources.name: Family Code of the Philippines / LCRO Roxas City

service: Building Permit & Ancillary Permits Application
description: Issuance of Building Permits and related ancillary permits (Architectural, Structural, Electrical, Sanitary/Plumbing, Mechanical) by the Office of the Building Official (OBO) / City Engineering Office of Roxas City.
steps: Submit five (5) sets of signed and sealed building plans and Unified Application Form at the OBO receiving counter, City Hall.
Technical review by structural, sanitary, architectural, electrical, and fire safety evaluators.
Receive order of payment and settle building permit fees at the City Treasury.
Claim Building Permit and construction logbook.
requirements: Certified True Copy of Transfer Certificate of Title (TCT) or Contract of Lease / Deed of Absolute Sale
Current Real Property Tax Receipt (Amilyar) and Tax Declaration
Five (5) complete sets of building plans signed and sealed by licensed professionals (Civil/Structural Engineer, Architect, Electrical Engineer, Master Plumber)
Locational / Zoning Clearance from City Planning Office
Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance (FSEC) from BFP Roxas City

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Property and prospective building owners in Roxas City

sources.name: Presidential Decree No. 1096 (National Building Code of the Philippines)
Office of the Building Official - Roxas City

service: CENRO Solid Waste Collection Schedule
description: Weekly residential and commercial solid waste collection schedule managed by the City Environment & Natural Resources Office (CENRO) Roxas City.
steps: Monday & Thursday: Brgy. Baybay, Culasi, Libas, Barra (Biodegradable Waste)
Tuesday & Friday: Brgy. Lawaan, Tanque, Inzo Arnaldo, Tiza, Banica (Biodegradable Waste)
Wednesday: All Barangays (Residual & Non-Biodegradable / Recyclables)
Daily Morning & Evening: Teodoro Arcenas Trade Center (TATC) Market & Downtown Commercial District
Saturday & Sunday: Coastal Cleanup & Special Eco-Corridor Collection
requirements: Strict waste segregation at source (Biodegradable vs. Non-biodegradable vs. Hazardous).
Place tied garbage bins or trash bags at collection points only between 6:00 AM - 7:30 AM.

quickInfo.whoCanApply: All Roxas City residents & business owners

sources.name: Republic Act No. 9003 (Ecological Solid Waste Management Act)
Roxas City Ecological Solid Waste Management Board

service: Cash Subsidy & Welfare Support for Solo Parents
description: Monthly financial aid, educational subsidy, and livelihood assistance provided to certified solo parents in Roxas City under RA 11861.
steps: Register and apply for Solo Parent ID at the CSWDO Roxas City.
Submit documentary proof of custody and single parenthood status.
Receive validated Solo Parent ID and inclusion in the city social benefit registry.
Receive designated periodic cash assistance payouts.
requirements: PSA Birth Certificate of dependent children
Barangay Certification of Solo Parent status and residency in Roxas City
Affidavit of Solo Parent declaring custody of children without support
Income Tax Return (ITR) or Certificate of Indigency

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Registered Solo Parents residing in Roxas City
quickInfo.documents: Valid Solo Parent ID, Proof of Custody

sources.name: Republic Act No. 11861 (Expanded Solo Parents Welfare Act)
CSWDO Roxas City Solo Parents Division

service: City Health Office & Health Station Directory
description: Comprehensive network of city health centers providing free primary care, immunization, maternal health, tuberculosis DOTS, and outpatient consultations.
steps: Main Center: Roxas City Health Office, City Hall Compound, Washington St.
Roxas City Diagnostic Center & Laboratory (Inzo Arnaldo Village)
Baybay & Culasi Coastal Health Sub-station (Purok Seafood, Baybay)
Lawaan & Tanque Primary Care Health Center
Animal Bite Treatment Center: City Health Office Compound
requirements: Barangay Health Card or Valid ID
PhilHealth Member Data Record (if available, though care is free for all indigents)

sources.name: Roxas City Health Office

service: Community Tax Certificate (Cedula) Issuance
description: Issuance of Community Tax Certificate (Individual or Corporate) required for notarized documents, government transactions, and business clearances in Roxas City.
steps: Fill out Cedula information slip at the Treasury assessment counter, City Hall or participating Barangay Hall.
State declared gross income or earnings from business/profession for the preceding year.
Pay basic tax (₱5.00) plus additional tax based on gross income (₱1.00 per ₱1,000 earnings).
Affix signature and thumbmark, and receive original Community Tax Certificate.
requirements: Valid Government ID
Proof of gross income (Payslip, ITR, or Certificate of Compensation if applicable)

quickInfo.fee: Statutory minimum ₱5.50 plus proportional income assessment
quickInfo.whoCanApply: Individuals aged 18 and above residing or employed in Roxas City

sources.name: Local Government Code of 1991 / City Treasury Office

service: Fisherfolk & Coastal Aquaculture Registration (BoatR & FishR)
description: Registration of municipal fisherfolk, motorized fishing vessels (3 gross tons and below), and coastal aquaculture operators in Roxas City under the City Agriculture Office.
steps: Secure registration forms at the City Agriculture Office (Fisheries Section), City Hall Compound.
Submit vessel specifications or aquaculture lease location details (fishponds, oyster/mussel beds in Sibuyan Sea estuaries).
Undergo vessel inspection and engine verification by City Coastal Law Enforcement officers.
Receive official Municipal Fisherfolk ID and BoatR vessel registration plates.
requirements: Barangay Certification of residency in a coastal barangay (Baybay, Culasi, Libas, Barra, etc.)
Vessel admeasurement certificate from authorized City Fishery Technician
Valid Government ID
Two (2) 1x1 recent ID photos

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Municipal fisherfolk and coastal fishpond/aquaculture operators in Roxas City

sources.name: Roxas City Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Management Council (CFARMC)

service: Issuance of Certified True Copy of Birth Certificate
description: Issuance of certified transcriptions and true copies of Certificate of Live Birth registered with the Local Civil Registry Office (LCRO) of Roxas City.
steps: Fill out request slip at the LCRO Public Assistance Counter, 1F Roxas City Hall.
Verify entry in the civil registry database or historical registry books.
Pay certification fee at the City Treasury cashier.
Present official receipt and claim certified document.
requirements: Valid Government-issued ID of document owner or requesting authorized party
Authorization Letter and ID of owner if applicant is a representative
Exact details: Full Name of child, Date of Birth, Place of Birth, Father's Name, Mother's Maiden Name

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Document owner, parent, legal guardian, or authorized representative

sources.name: Local Civil Registry Office - City Government of Roxas

service: Mangrove Reforestation & Coastal Greenbelt Tree Planting
description: Community environmental initiative supporting coastal resilience through mangrove seedling donation, technical planting guidance, and protected coastal zone monitoring in Palina and Sibuyan waterways.
steps: Submit letter of intent or tree-planting request to CENRO Roxas City.
Receive briefing on designated mangrove planting zones (Palina, Culasi, or Dayao estuaries).
Claim mangrove propagules/seedlings at the City Eco-Park nursery.
Participate in guided coastal planting activity with community fisherfolk stewards.
requirements: Written Request / Community Activity Proposal
Identification of participating organization or institution

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Schools, NGOs, civic organizations, and youth groups

sources.name: CENRO Roxas City Coastal Resource Management Unit

service: Medical & Crisis Assistance (AICS)
description: Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situations providing financial grants for hospitalization, prescription medicines, diagnostic laboratory tests, and burial assistance.
steps: Submit complete documentary requirements at the City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO) Help Desk.
Undergo social case evaluation and assessment with a registered social worker.
Receive Guarantee Letter (GL) for partner hospitals or proceed to City Treasury for cash grant disbursement.
requirements: Medical Certificate / Clinical Abstract from attending doctor
Hospital Bill or Official Prescription with price quotation
Barangay Certificate of Indigency from Roxas City barangay of residence
Valid Government-issued ID of claimant and patient

sources.name: DSWD Memorandum Circular No. 02 Series of 2014
CSWDO Roxas City Guidelines on Crisis Intervention

service: National Police Clearance & Roxas City PNP Assistance
description: Online application processing, biometric capture, and issuance of National Police Clearance at the Roxas City Police Station.
steps: Register and schedule an appointment online via https://pnpclearance.ph.
Pay the statutory police clearance fee through authorized Landbank/GCash payment channels.
Proceed to Roxas City Police Station (Corner Bilbao & Arzobispo St.) on scheduled date.
Undergo biometric capture (fingerprints, photo, digital signature) and claim printed clearance.
requirements: Two (2) Valid Government-issued IDs
Official Payment Reference Number / Receipt
Barangay Clearance

sources.name: Philippine National Police - Roxas City Police Station

service: New Business Permit Application (Mayor's Permit)
description: Application for a new Mayor's Permit and business license to operate a commercial, trading, or industrial establishment within Roxas City via the Business One-Stop Shop (BOSS).
steps: Submit Unified Business Application Form at the Business Permits & Licensing Office (BPLO), City Hall Compound.
Receive automated one-stop assessment from City Engineering, City Health, CENRO, and BFP.
Pay corresponding business taxes, regulatory fees, and fire inspection fee at the City Treasury cashier.
Claim Mayor's Business Permit and official Business Plate.
requirements: DTI Business Name Registration (Sole Proprietorship) or SEC Certificate of Registration (Corporation/Partnership)
Barangay Business Clearance from the barangay where business is situated
Contract of Lease (if renting) or Land Title / Tax Declaration (if owned)
Zoning & Locational Clearance from City Planning Office
Sanitary Permit from City Health Office
Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (FSIC) from BFP Roxas City

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Entrepreneurs and corporate entities operating in Roxas City

sources.name: Roxas City Business Permits and Licensing Office (BPLO)
Republic Act No. 11032 (Ease of Doing Business Act)

service: Public & Private School Directory
description: Comprehensive directory of public and private educational institutions in Roxas City under the DepEd Schools Division of Roxas City and CHED Region VI.
steps: Capiz National High School (Fuentes Drive, Roxas City - Premier Public Secondary School)
President Manuel A. Roxas Memorial School North & South (Poblacion)
Roxas City School for Philippine Craftsmen (Brgy. Culasi)
Tanque National High School (Brgy. Tanque)
Don Ynocencio A. Del Rosario National High School (Brgy. Dayao)
Capiz State University - CAPSU Main Campus (Fuentes Drive)
Filamer Christian University (Roxas Avenue - Established 1904)
Colegio de la Purisima Concepcion (Arzobispo St. - Archdiocesan Catholic Institution)

faqs.question: When does enrollment typically begin?
faqs.answer: Basic education enrollment follows DepEd national schedules, usually between June and July. Higher education institutions begin admissions from April through August.

sources.name: DepEd Schools Division Office of Roxas City

service: Real Property Tax Payment (Amilyar)
description: Assessment and payment of annual Real Property Tax (RPT) on land, buildings, and machinery in Roxas City, offering up to 20% prompt-payment discount for early settlement.
steps: Present previous year's Official Receipt or Tax Declaration number at the City Assessor / Treasury Window, Roxas City Hall.
Receive statement of account detailing current year tax due and applicable prompt payment discount.
Pay in cash, manager's check, or authorized electronic banking channel.
Receive official receipt and tax clearance validation.
requirements: Previous Year Official Receipt of RPT payment
Tax Declaration / Title number
Valid Government ID of property owner or authorized representative

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Real property owners in Roxas City

sources.name: City Treasurer's Office - Roxas City

service: Roxas City Animal Bite Treatment Center
description: Post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) anti-rabies vaccination, wound cleaning, and tetanus toxoid administration for animal bite victims.
steps: Wash animal bite or scratch thoroughly with running water and soap for at least 15 minutes.
Proceed immediately to the Roxas City Animal Bite Treatment Center at City Hall Compound.
Triage evaluation and bite category assessment by attending nurse/physician.
Administration of anti-rabies vaccine and scheduling of subsequent booster doses.
requirements: Patient identification (or parent/guardian if minor)
Animal observation data (status of the biting dog/cat)

sources.name: National Rabies Prevention and Control Program (DOH)

service: Roxas City Tertiary Educational Assistance (Mayor's Scholarship)
description: Financial tuition and stipend support granted to deserving underprivileged college students residing in Roxas City.
steps: Secure application form from the Local Youth Development Office (LYDO) at Roxas City Hall Compound.
Submit certified true copy of grades (GWA 85% or 2.0 with no failing mark).
Undergo socio-economic interview and verification with CSWDO social assessors.
Attend scholarship orientation and claim semester grant payout at the City Treasury Office.
requirements: Certificate of Indigency from Barangay of residence in Roxas City
Official Certificate of Enrollment / Registration from accredited college/university
Certified True Copy of Grades from preceding semester
Voter's Certification of parent/guardian or applicant (Roxas City voter)

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Bona fide college students residing in Roxas City

sources.name: City Government of Roxas - LYDO

service: Senior Citizens Milestone Welfare & Centenarian Program
description: Provision of local cash incentives and national milestone honors for senior citizens celebrating milestone ages (80, 85, 90, 95, and 100) facilitated by OSCA Roxas City.
steps: Verify that the senior citizen is registered with the Office for the Senior Citizens' Affairs (OSCA) Roxas City.
Secure claim template and orientation at the OSCA Office, City Hall Compound.
Submit valid IDs and proof of milestone age for cross-verification.
Proceed to the City Treasury Office for cash gift release or receive home delivery for bedridden seniors.
requirements: PSA Birth Certificate or Valid Senior Citizen ID issued by OSCA Roxas City
Barangay Certification of Residency confirming continuous residence in Roxas City
For representatives of bedridden seniors: Authorization Letter and Proof of Life photo

faqs.question: Where is OSCA Roxas City located?
faqs.answer: The Office for Senior Citizens' Affairs is located at the City Hall Compound, Washington St., Roxas City.

faqs.question: Are home visits conducted for bedridden seniors?
faqs.answer: Yes, OSCA and CSWDO staff conduct personal home visits for bedridden centenarians and milestone seniors to deliver benefits directly.

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Senior citizens aged 80, 85, 90, 95, and 100 residing in Roxas City
quickInfo.documents: Senior Citizen ID, Proof of Age

sources.name: National Commission of Senior Citizens (NCSC)
Office for the Senior Citizens' Affairs (OSCA) Roxas City
